name: drag-curl-barbell
title: Drag Curl: Barbell
primer: This exercise works the biceps and forearms.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent, and your abs drawn in.
Grasp the bar with palms up, shoulder width apart.
Extend your arms fully so they are against your thighs.
Slowly raise the bar, keeping it against your body and drawing your elbows back, until it touches your chest.
tips: This exercise is credited to the late Vince Gironda, the "Iron Guru".
Do not move your shoulders during this exercise.
